Statically it works of course. 

But when i go dynamic with the reactive() functions, i wonder how i solve this one

  text <- reactive({ 
    text = laply(tweets(), function(x) x$getText() )
  })

tweets() is another reactive function, which works, so i can generate dynamic output from there. 
But i have difficulties to understand AND combine the structure of laply with shiny. 

my output from tweet is an "status-object". 
Basically my inner function does have to be reactive too since it depends on my reactive
tweets() - function, but i can not figure out to solve it for x$getText()

my tweets() output is type "status". Do i have to go over a for loop or is there another way? 

Kind Regards
